verdict.rationale: An in-editor AI assistant is a fair capability for a game engine to ship, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no built-in AI-generated insights or suggestions in Godot. The editor plugin system, EditorInterface, the built-in GDScript LSP and community MCP servers are developer building blocks or third-party tools, not a first-party capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
